name: Clean Shopping Cart Button
author: Mutt Group / Mutt Studio

sections.description:
Clean Shopping Cart Button adds a convenient button to WooCommerce that allows customers to empty their shopping cart with a single click.
It also includes admin settings to enable/disable the feature and customize the button text.

Features:
– Add a “Clean Cart” button to your WooCommerce cart page.
– Easily enable or disable the button from the admin panel.
– Customize the button label to fit your store’s tone.
– Multi-language support: English and Portuguese (pt_BR).

Author: muttgroup

A brief Markdown Example

Here’s what you can do with this plugin:

  1. Give your customers a quick way to clear their cart.
  2. Control the button’s text and visibility from the admin panel.
  3. Simplify cart management and improve UX.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Clean Cart Button to configure the settings.
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

It adds a button to the WooCommerce cart page that allows users to clear all items from their cart with one click.

Can I change the button text?

Yes! You can customize the label from the plugin settings page in the WordPress admin.

Can I disable the button without removing the plugin?

Absolutely. There’s a simple toggle in the settings to enable or disable the feature.

Is it compatible with multilingual sites?

Yes, the plugin supports English and Portuguese (pt_BR) languages.
